P&O’s legendary ‌ Pacific Explorer leaves Australia for last time
After nearly a decade in​ Aussie waters, the ship’s last cruise under the P&O banner⁢ saw her depart Fremantle in⁣ Western Australia⁢ last‍ night on an 11-night cruise to Singapore. The final farewell came after news that the iconic‍ P&O brand is disappearing from our shores.
Pacific Explorer Has A New Home – Iconic Aussie Ship ‌Sold To asian
P&O Cruises beloved Australia ship Pacific Explorer has been sold; The ship will now​ sail as Star Scorpio⁣ for Resorts World ‌Cruises; Pacific Explorer was a favorite ship ‍amongst Aussie cruisers – sailing ‍all around the country.
The End ⁤of an Era – Fremantle Shipping News
One onlooker told me⁤ his father had ⁤worked for P&O all his ​life and would⁢ be turning in⁤ his grave‌ wiht P&O’s departure from Australia. Star Voyager, the ship Pacific Explorer is destined to become, will now sail under a new​ banner.
Goodbye To An Australian Cruise Legend‌ – Pacific Explorer Heads For New Life In Asia
Pacific Explorer, once a beloved ship of P&O Cruises Australia, has set sail for ⁢the last time under its ⁤original name, marking the end of⁤ an era for Australian cruising. The ship is now ​headed to asia to begin a new chapter‌ with Resorts World Cruises .
Farewell to Pacific Explorer: Iconic Australian ‌Cruise ⁣Ship Sets Sail for Asia The departure of P&O’s Pacific ‍Explorer from Australian‌ waters marks a poignant end to an era. After nearly a​ decade serving as a ⁢favorite amongst Aussie cruisers, the cruise ship‌ embarked on its final ‍voyage from Fremantle, heading⁢ for⁣ a new life in Asia under the banner of Resorts World Cruises.
